capabilities: Search multiple book catalogs by title, ISBN or barcode
Merge conflicting metadata fields from different sources field by field
Create book notes from ready-made or custom templates with Templater support
Check for duplicate notes by ISBN or file name and update their metadata
Browse and bulk-import from a Calibre library or an ISBN list
disambiguation: It searches online book catalogs and your Calibre library, not the notes inside your vault.
extras: StoryGraph login uses two browser cookies that work like a password; the free LibraryThing token allows 50 searches a day; the Google Books key is stored in data.json while other credentials go to Obsidian's secret storage.
intentEvidence: It builds on obsidian-book-search-plugin by anpigon.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up book metadata across multiple catalogs and turn it into a structured book note with frontmatter and cover.

relations.evidence: It builds on obsidian-book-search-plugin by anpigon.
If the Templater plugin is installed and is not already set to run on new files, the plugin runs it
Turn on Calibre's content server (Connect/share → Start Content server
The most complete source: translators, original titles, first publication, series, genres, characters, places, ASINs.
StoryGraph has no public API and puts a Cloudflare check in front of every request that is not signed in
Google Books works without a key, but the free quota it shares with every user often runs out
The exact edition an ISBN names, often with its original title and translator; open data and covers.
The plugin searches LibraryThing through its Talpa Search API, which needs a free API token.

summary: Book search plugin that queries Goodreads, StoryGraph, Google Books, Open Library, Hardcover, LibraryThing and Calibre to build templated book notes.
